text:
I took the plate as a standard dinner plate of about 26 cm.

The brown loaf is roughly 11 cm long, 6 cm wide and 5 cm tall. That is about 330 cm³, and at a density near 0.9 g/cm³ it weighs around 290 g. It looks like meatloaf, or possibly a dense bread-like loaf. I judged it to be meatloaf, at roughly 190 kcal per 100 g.

There are six sushi pieces, each about 3.5 cm across and 3 cm tall, so about 30 g each.
- Two spicy crab rolls topped with tobiko or orange roe, about 60 g together.
- Two California-style rolls with crab, avocado and cucumber, about 60 g together.
- Two rolls with sesame seeds and crab (surimi), about 65 g together.

I put sushi at about 140 kcal per 100 g.
